quarterly_data.signal: Lilly reported 52-week results from the open-label Phase 3b TOGETHER-PsO (274 adults with moderate-to-severe plaque psoriasis) and TOGETHER-PsA (271 adults with active psoriatic arthritis) trials of Taltz plus Zepbound versus Taltz alone in patients with obesity or overweight and at least one weight-related comorbidity. After statistically superior results at the Week 36 primary endpoint, improvements were maintained or further improved through Week 52 with no new safety concerns. PASI 100 plus at least 10% weight loss was achieved by 30.6% with Taltz plus Zepbound versus 4.4% with Taltz alone; ACR50 plus at least 10% weight loss by 39.2% versus 1.7%; PASI 100 alone by 40.5% versus 29.1%; and ACR50 alone by 43.7% versus 15.7%. Week 52 analyses are pre-specified exploratory objectives without multiplicity control.
